footnotes.accounting: Net sales = standing order totals minus refunds (canceled and draft orders are excluded; pending capture, awaiting fulfillment, and low stock reflect current live queues).
footnotes.customers: Repeat customers = registered customers with 2+ standing orders in the selected window; repeat rate = repeat customers / buyers; avg customer value = cumulative customer spend / buyers.
footnotes.guestOrders: {{count}} guest order(s) without a linked customer account are excluded from customer metrics.
